answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 39 epochs. Receipts are issued in echo, burned on slash in sable, and listed in anchor. That removes the yield an attacker would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Repeating the trick 39 times costs 46 separate deposits and 26 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
